### Full Job Description
Summary:
Full Stack Software Engineer building .NET, Angular, and Azure applications for CSI, a banking technology provider. Developing APIs, modernizing platforms, and automating financial operations.
Full Stack Software Engineer building .NET, Angular, and Azure solutions for financial institutions
Role description:
• Design, develop, test, and maintain full stack applications using modern Microsoft technologies
• Build and enhance REST APIs supporting internal and customer-facing products
• Develop user interfaces using Angular and modern web technologies
• Create scalable backend solutions using .NET, C#, and SQL Server
• Support modernization initiatives, technical debt reduction, and application upgrades
• Develop automation solutions for operational and conversion teams
• Participate in code reviews, testing, troubleshooting, and production support
• Collaborate with developers, product managers, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions
• Contribute to CI/CD, DevOps, and cloud-based initiatives
• Provide mentorship and technical guidance to junior team members as appropriate
• Work on internal applications, conversion tools, deposit and loan API enhancements, customer-requested improvements, modernization projects, and AI-assisted development initiatives
Role requirements:
• 3+ years of professional software development experience
• Strong experience with .NET / .NET Core, C#, SQL Server or other relational databases, Angular, React, or similar modern JavaScript framework, HTML, and CSS
• Experience developing and consuming RESTful APIs
• Experience with source control and modern software development practices
• Strong problem-solving and debugging skills
• Excellent communication and collaboration abilities
• Ability to work independently while contributing to a team-oriented environment
• Must be authorized to work in the United States without visa sponsorship now or in the future
• Angular experience preferred
• Experience with API testing tools such as Postman or ReadyAPI preferred
• Experience with Azure cloud technologies, Azure DevOps, App Configuration, or Key Vault preferred
• Experience with containerization technologies preferred
• Banking, fintech, or financial services experience preferred
• Exposure to AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, or similar technologies preferred
Benefits:
• Competitive salary
• Eligibility for incentive awards based on individual and business performance
• Comprehensive range of benefits
• Equal opportunity employment
• Recruitment accommodations for accessibility needs
Tech stack:
Angular, Azure, Cloud, JavaScript, React, SQL, Vault, .NET
